name: LBW Love Beyond Wicket
description: A former cricket star becomes a coach and leads struggling students who unite to preserve a legacy while finding their own paths.

name: IPL Indian Penal Law
description: Gunasekaran, a middle-class family man turned cab operator, finds his life upended when his car is misused by a corrupt cop linked to a serious crime. Suddenly pulled into a dangerous web of police, politics, and false accusations, he is forced to fight for his survival in Madurai. With Anbu stepping in to help, the story follows their tense struggle to uncover the truth and escape a trap set by powerful forces.

name: Konja Naal Poru Thalaiva
description: A young man working in a private company falls in love with a girl who is searching for a job. Their relationship is disrupted when he clashes with a local goon who attacks his uncle. Hurt and disappointed, the girl distances herself from him, pushing him into deep despair. When he tries to end his life, he is stopped by a ghost who once committed suicide. What follows is a journey that reminds him why every life is worth fighting for.

name: Kombuseevi
description: Having a miserable past of being evacuated from their homeland and losing their livelihood, Rokkapuli and Pandi are among the main people of the village who aspire to become millionaires by peddling ganja marijuana. Can they successfully achieve their dream?

name: Dhoolpet Police Station
description: Set in the volatile area of Dhoolpet, this crime thriller follows a deadly trail of decapitation murders during a vibrant festival, pushing cops into a high-stakes chase where every clue is soaked in danger.

name: Tere Ishk Mein
description: Some souls are meant to collide. Some love stories are destined to burn brighter.

name: Mark
description: Ajay Markandaya, a suspended police officer, rises against antisocial elements, gangsters, and corrupt politicians. When a critical situation unfolds, he must confront these forces to restore justice and ensure a better future for the state and its people.

name: Sirai
description: Sirai is a Tamil movie starring Vikram Prabhu and Anishma Anilkumar in prominent roles. It is directed by Suresh Rajakumari.

name: Kumki 2
description: A young lonely boy discovers an elephant trapped in a pit and saves its life. Over time, they become inseparable. But when his mother sells the elephant, their bond is torn apart. Will he ever find his lost friend again?

name: Thalaikanam
description: The film chronicles the journey of an independent, egocentric couple, Vidya and Vasu. Their love journey begins after the wedding, arranged by their parents. But when ego is more important than a relationship, its hard to sail.

name: 2K Heart
description: 2K Heart is a Tamil movie starring Power Star Srinivasan and Chaplin Balu in prominent roles. It is directed by J Santhosh Kumar.

name: Middle Class
description: Karl Marx, a middle-class man with a simple dream of owning farmland, lives a routine life with his outspoken wife and two children. When an unexpected opportunity finally brings his dream within reach, chaos and pressure push him into a frantic, heartfelt journey. Middle Class follows his race against time to change his life.

name: Poomara Kathu
description: Udhir at Poomara Kathu is a Tamil movie starring Santhosh Saravanan, D Singampuli, Devadarshini and Manobala Mahadevan in prominent roles. It is directed Gnana Arockiaraj.

name: Maadan Kodai Vizha
description: Maadan Kodai Vizha is a Tamil movie starring Gokul Gowtham, Sharumiishaa, Suria Narayanan and Supergood Subramani in prominent roles. It is directed by R. Thangapandi.

name: Kasivu
description: Kasivu (2025) is a Tamil film directed by Varathan, adapted from writer Poomani's short story, starring M.S. Bhaskar, Vijayalakshmi, and Varadhan Chenbagavalli, exploring raw themes of struggle, responsibility, and freedom

name: Raat Akeli Hai The Bansal Murders
description: When members of the Bansal family are found murdered, Inspector Jatil Yadav uncovers a trail of greed, betrayal and secrets tied to a deadly conspiracy.

name: Little Hearts
description: Akhil`s failure in the EAMCET exam pushes him into the grind of long-term coaching, where academic pressure and personal heartbreak collide. Struggling to find meaning, he discovers the fine line between shallow attraction and true love. At the coaching centre, he meets Khatyayani, a girl who captures his heart instantly. But when she rejects him for a strange, unexpected reason, Akhil`s life takes a new turn. Refusing to let go, he embarks on a journey filled with humour, heart, and transformation, one that not only tests his resolve to win her over but also reshapes his understanding of love and life itself.

name: AIR All India Rankers
description: Three students from different backgrounds unite at an elite college, questioning their paths. With help from an unconventional teacher, they challenge the system's rigid expectations while discovering their true identities.

name: Premante
description: After a charming meet-cute leads to an arranged marriage, a wife`s suspicions about her husband`s strange behaviour unravel their seemingly perfect relationship, leading to a shocking revelation that forces them to redefine their understanding of love and commitment.

name: Retta Thala
description: Retta Thala is a Tamil movie starring Arun Vijay, Siddhi Idnani, Yogesh Samy and John Vijay in prominent roles. It is written and directed by Kris Thirukumaran.

name: Bha Bha Ba
description: A faceless nobody unleashes statewide chaos to carve his identity, fueled by vengeance and a haunting past. As his power rises, the system launches an all-out war to stop the storm he has become.

name: Bank of Bhagyalakshmi
description: A crew of five amateur thieves reunite for one final score in a village brimming with elections. With no experience and only a reckless plan, things dont go as expected. Will they make it out, or will the village remember them only as five fools who gambled with fate?

name: Dhandoraa
description: Raw, rooted drama where humour and heart collide with hard truths. Born from the soil, it beats to the rhythm of resistance, humanity, and hope.

name: Mowgli
description: In the battle between love and lust, a tribal man fights to save his deaf and mute girlfriend from a ruthless forest officer, unravelling a cat-and-mouse drama within the heart of the forest.

name: Mask
description: 440 crores stolen. Seven days to get it back. A game of greed, betrayal and intrigue culminates in an explosive climax in this story of a greedy man, a conniving woman, and an uncanny guy with a bag full of tricks.

name: Akhanda 2
description: God of Masses Nandamuri Balakrishna, Blockbuster Maker Boyapati Sreenu, Raam Achanta, Gopi Achanta, 14 Reels Plus, M Tejaswini Nandamuri Presents Akhanda 2: Thaandavam

description: Bigg Boss Tamil Season 9, hosted by Vijay Sethupathi,. The show features 20 contestants living together in a creatively designed house with a unicorn-themed entrance and luxurious interiors. The season’s tagline, “Paakka paakka thaan theriyum, poga poga thaan puriyum,” hints at gradual revelations and surprises. Contestants like Subiksha Krishnan, Gana Vinoth Kumar

name: Salliyargal
description: Set against the Tamil Eelam war backdrop, the story follows brave doctors working in an underground bunker, risking their lives to save both allies and enemies. As they battle danger, moral dilemmas, and relentless chaos, their unwavering compassion and humanity shine through, highlighting courage and resilience in the darkest times.

name: The Bed
description: The Bed unfolds entirely through the perspective of a bed, which silently witnesses lives, emotions, secrets, love, pain, and the many untold moments that happen around it. Through this unusual narrator, the story explores relationships and hidden truths in a deeply unique way.

name: Eko
description: In the misty hills of Kaattukunnu, Mlaathi Chedathi and Peeyoos struggle to survive unforeseen challenges as the chronicles of Kuriyachan, a multifaceted businessman and outlaw, blur the line between myth, longing, and reckoning, revealing that he forever rules the hills.

name: Drive
description: A powerful media mogul becomes the target of a ruthless hacker, pulling him into a deadly game where his reputation, fortune and family are on the line.

name: Yellow
description: Yellow is a Tamil movie starring Poornima Ravi, Vaibhav Murugesan, Sai Prasanna and Namitha Krishnan Moorthy in prominent roles. It is written and directed by Hari Mahadevan.

name: Revolver Rita
description: Rita's peaceful Pondicherry existence shatters when her family gets caught in gang violence. She must use her wits and bravery to protect them from dangerous criminals.

description: Rajini and Maina elope using a stolen thali for a quick wedding, unaware it carries a tragic past. When Maina becomes possessed by Ponnarasi

description: A woman is abandoned, deceived, and wounded, but she rises again with pride. Saayavanam traces Sita

name: 90s A Middle Class Biopic
description: A nostalgic trip down memory lane, delving into the everyday life of a middle-class family.

name: Others
description: When a series of IVF-born infants are afflicted with severe, unexplained conditions, the protagonist, a cop unravels a dark conspiracy involving blacklisted steroids, anonymous donors, and compromised hospitals - as he hunts an invisible criminal who turns hope into horror.

name: Dominic and the Ladies Purse
description: Dominic, a struggling detective, agrees to find the owner of a lost purse, unaware that it will pull him into a deeper mystery.

name: Date with Saie
description: An aspiring filmmaker, Raghunath wants to make a film with Marathi superstar Saie Tamhankar as his heroine. What happens when his admiration becomes a dangerous obsession, blurring boundaries?

name: Pharma
description: The series is about the struggles of a middle-class boy who joins the pharmaceutical industry as a medical representative in his 20s. His struggle to understand the rules of the game, his growing through his ranks in his 30s where he has to stand against corruption in the industry.

name: Un Paarvayil
description: Unpaarvayil is a Tamil movie starring Ganesh Venkatram and Parvathy Nair in prominent roles. It is a drama directed by Kabir Lal.

name: Mrs Deshpande
description: Police seek help from imprisoned serial killer to catch a copycat murderer mimicking her methods.

name: Dawood
description: An unsuspecting cab driver takes up a petty job, only to fall into the deadly trap of a ruthless gangster. Now, he must fight for survival or accept that he was born to be hunted

name: Nadu Center
description: A troubled basketball star transfers to a chaotic school and is tasked with forming a team from its most disruptive students. Through coaching, he discovers leadership while helping his teammates find purpose.

name: Heartiley Battery
description: Sophia always grew up believing that love is nothing but a figment of science. At 24, she builds a Love Meter to evade heartbreaks and meets Sid, a free-spirited writer, who soon falls for her.

name: Yaaru Potta Kodu
description: In a village trapped by untouchability and superstition, a determined teacher and his students challenge long-standing injustice. Their fight sparks a powerful movement that unites the community and threatens the local oppressor. As hope rises and conflict intensifies, the village stands at a decisive moment where courage must overcome the shadows of the past.

name: Sooriyanum Sooriyagandhiyum
description: Sooriyanum Sooriyagandhiyum is a Tamil movie starring Appu Kutty and Sri Hari in prominent roles. It is written and directed by A.L. Raja.

name: Single Papa
description: A newly-divorced "man-child" shocks his family by adopting a baby. As chaos unfolds, the immature Gaurav Gehlot must navigate single parenthood while his bewildered relatives adjust to the situation.

name: Sister Midnight
description: In Mumbai, an arranged marriage spirals into darkness as the spineless husband watches his wife morph into a ruthless, feral force within their marital confines.

name: Kaantha
description: Kaantha is a period drama set in 1950s Madras, directed by Selvamani Selvaraj. Featuring Dulquer Salmaan, Samuthirakani, and Bhagyashri Borse, the film brings a pan-Indian cinematic experience to life.

name: Aaromaley
description: A hopeless romantic, Ajith believes love is movie magic, but his life is a series of misunderstandings. After a fiasco, his parents force him to work at a matrimony agency. There, he clashes with his pragmatic boss, Anjali, who believes love is pure logic. Their dynamic forces Ajith to learn that love must be earned. By the time he understands this truth, love is gone. Years later, destiny offers him one last chance. Will love wait this time?

name: Kinaru
description: This is a heartwarming story about four young boys who embark on an epic adventure toward their mythical "Dreaming Well." The film focuses entirely on the theme of pure childhood nostalgia and the unbreakable bonds of youth.

name: Theeyavar Kulai Nadunga
description: When writer Jeba is murdered at midnight, the calm of an upscale apartment complex shatters. Inspector Magudapathi, known for his unorthodox methods, delves into the residents

name: Brat
description: Brat is a gripping tale of a young man named Kristy who is driven to defy his father, Constable Mahadevaiah, and his unwavering commitment to honesty. The film explores the thrilling and unpredictable journey that unfolds from the tensions between youthful ambitions and the principles of a righteous parent.

name: 12A Railway Colony
description: When easygoing Karthik falls head over heels for his charming neighbour, he thinks love is simple. But the closer he gets, the more tangled his world becomes, full of hidden truths, shocking lies, and unexpected twists

name: Mella Thiranthathu Manasu
description: The movie is directed by Tatineni Satya Prakash and is made under the banner of Sree Leela movies. It released in the year 2014. The cast includes Shashikant, Manasa, Rahul Dev, Giri Babu, Ali and M S Narayana.

name: Padayappa
description: The death of Padaiyappa's father destroys his family. But his luck changes, and he is able to lead a prosperous life, until his nemesis plots to ruin his happiness once more.

name: Matsya Kaand
description: A master of disguise, a charmer, and a smooth talker - this is a story about genius conman Matsya Thada. Fate throws him a curveball when a cunning and ruthless cop wants to apprehend him at any cost.

name: Unnaal Ennaal
description: Three youth come to Chennai in search of livelihood. Will they take an an opportunity to get rid of their need for money? Or did they decide that conscientious humanity is what matters?

name: Iru Dhuruvam
description: The series consists of hard-core police investigation stories dealing with investigation, detection and suspense.

name: Robinhood
description: Ram, a modern-day Robin Hood, is a master thief who unexpectedly finds himself switching sides. When fate forces him to become the personal security officer for Neera, a rollercoaster ride of action, comedy, and unexpected twists follows.

name: Paanch Minar
description: When Chotu`s surprise party for his don father ends in tragedy, he inherits the criminal empire and uncovers his uncle Murthy`s deceit. Meanwhile, Kittu, a struggling cab driver pretending to be deaf, becomes entangled in danger after unknowingly helping twin murderers.

name: The Girlfriend
description: Directed by Rahul Ravindran, The Girlfriend is a feature film starring Rashmika Mandanna and Dheekshith Shetty.

name: Nirvaagam Porupalla
description: Nirvaagam Porupalla tracks a cybercrime gang that steals money through deceptive WhatsApp links and fake APK files. As victims fall prey, one man digs deeper into the scam, uncovering a dangerous network hidden behind everyday technology.

name: Dies Irae
description: Rohan's affluent lifestyle spirals out of control as he becomes convinced there is a supernatural entity in his home. As he starts to uncover the mystery, he is drawn into unexpected worlds and alliances, along with the horrors that lie ahead.

name: Bhaukaal
description: Naveen Sikhera makes his way into the sin city as the new SSP, he is hit by the prevailing chaos and lawlessness in the city. Muzaffarnagar is ruled by Shaukeen gang in the east and the Dedha brothers rule the west.

name: Real Kashmir Football Club
description: From the heart of Kashmir, an incredible true story of grit, passion, and glory unfolds. More than a game: witness how two dreamers and 20 underdogs defied despair to build India's most unlikely professional football club. Against all odds, their journey created a powerful movement of unity that swept across the valley.

name: Stephen
description: A psychiatrist investigates a self-confessed serial killer after nine girls disappear, only to question whether he's guilty or a victim in a darker game.

name: Kadhal Kanave
description: - Viraj is living his dream life in the US but is forced to move back to Ahmedabad due to visa issues. During this time, he meets Nivedita, an architecture student, who is completely opposite to him. Now, Viraj must make a choice. Will he choose to go back or stay here?

name: BP 180
description: BP 180 is a Tamil movie starring Tanya S Ravichandran, Daniel Balaji and K. Bhagyaraj in prominent roles. It is directed and written by JP.

name: The Pet Detective
description: Motivated to win the hand of his sweetheart, Kaikeyi Menon, Tony Jose Alula joins his father`s detective agency. Starting as a `Pet Detective`, Tony`s cases quickly escalate into a dangerous kidnapping involving international smugglers. With rival Inspector Rajath constantly in his way, Tony must solve the case, clear his name, and prove he is worthy of Kaikeyi`s love.

name: Aan Paavam Pollathathu
description: A year into their marriage, unable to distinguish between toxicity and mere misunderstandings, Sakthi decides to part ways with Siva. The story unfolds as the couple navigates their separation, and whether they ultimately proceed with divorce forms the emotional climax. A hilarious face-off between an online feminist and a pseudo-Periyarist, the film offers a witty, heartfelt take on modern relationships, packed with laughter, drama, and emotion.

name: Kuttram Purindhavan
description: When a girl vanishes in a small town, a retiring pharmacist, the child's mother, and a local cop become entangled in a web of secrets and guilt as they search for answers and confront hidden truths.

name: Gajaana
description: A group of greedy individuals venture into the Nagamalai forest, only to face mysterious deaths one by one. As they confront supernatural forces, they must unravel the mystery and find a way to escape the deadly forest. Will they find a way out or succumb to the forest`s secrets?

name: Cristina Kathirvelan
description: Cristina Kathirvelan starring Kaushik Ram, Pratibha and others. Directed by SJN Alex Pandian.

name: Aaryan
description: A middle-aged, failed writer stuns everyone when he boldly declares that he is about to commit the perfect crime. What follows is a gripping cat-and-mouse chase as a determined cop and his team race against time to stop a chillingly well-planned series of murders.

name: Regai
description: SI Vetri investigates a medical team that is trying to cover up deaths of clinical trial participants by staging them as accidents. Can Vetri put an end to this sinister plot before it's too late?

name: Mass Jathara
description: Mass Jathara is a Telugu action entertainer directed by Bhanu Bogavarapu, featuring Ravi Teja and Sree Leela in pivotal roles.

name: Amala
description: Amala portrays the journey of a brilliant police officer who is entrusted with the task of solving a series of murders happening in the city overnight. He sets out to find clues that would lead him to the killer.

name: Happy Birthday Luci
description: Everything has two sides-Good and Evil, God and Satan. While many worship God, a few follow Satan. Crimson, a devout Satanist, is tasked with building a Satanic Church. But before construction can begin, he must sacrifice six firstborns, all born on June 6th, 1996, at 6:06 am. The story follows Crimson`s quest to find these individuals and whether he successfully completes the ritual. This is a fictional tale, with no resemblance to real events or people.

name: Ondu Sarala Prema Kathe
description: Athishay is a young man who wants to become a music director. Anu is a kind hearted and caring woman. When it comes to love, being a musician Athishay dreams of a woman who matches the rhythm of his heartbeat, and Anu is waiting for a person who is genuine

name: Murugesan Plus 2
description: A truck driver named Murugesan leads a double life with two families. What happens when, after a major accident and his presumed death, the two families fight over his wealth?

name: Bison
description: This is a tale of guts, grit, and glory in the life of a young man who faced a world that seemed like a Goliath compared to his own David-like struggles. A story of a boy who defied the lines on his hand to achieve what no one thought possible: to choose sport over a gun, peace over violence and life over death.

name: Ziddi Ishq
description: Mehul's one-sided love is so strong and eternal that she will do anything for her crush - in life or in death

name: The Family Man
description: On a personal mission to avenge an assassination, Srikant Tiwari unravels a devious conspiracy that threatens to send India to the brink of war.

name: Right
description: A desperate father`s search for his missing son takes a terrifying turn when he becomes trapped inside a police station. As a mysterious entity seals the building, he and the others inside are forced to confront their darkest secrets in a deadly game.

name: Daksha The Deadly Conspiracy
description: Daksha: The Deadly Conspiracy is a pulse-pounding thriller with high-octane action, shocking twists, and an undercurrent of supernatural intrigue. It tells the story of one womans fiery determination to torch a fortress of corruption. As the clock ticks, she discovers the conspiracy runs deeper than she ever imagined, and in this world of fire and deception, the quest for truth comes at a devastating price. Will Daksha rise, or will she burn?

name: Arjun Chakravarthy
description: Set in 1970s-80s India, Arjun Chakravarthy is a gripping tale of passion, perseverance, and patriotism. Based on the true story of a forgotten kabaddi legend, the film follows Arjun`s rise from village grounds to national glory, overcoming poverty, politics, and personal loss. Blending high-intensity sports action with heartfelt drama, this inspiring film honours a hero who played for pride, not fame.

name: Bairavan
description: Bairan Palli is a Telugu movie starring Krishna Manjusha in the lead role.

name: Diesel
description: Diesel follows an ambitious young trader who gets entangled in the dangerous, high-stakes world of the diesel mafia. He must battle powerful black-market barons and corrupt officials to survive.

name: Network
description: Srujan, Kiran, Swetcha and Srinu are addicted to their phones. Will it mess up their lives? Watch ultimate thrilling series 'Network' on aha

name: Madras Mafia Company
description: A feared gangster, Poongavanam, rules Chennai for over 25 years without a single FIR against him. When a suo motu case targets him, the government assigns IPS officer Thigazh Bharathi on an undercover mission to dismantle his empire amidst betrayal, violence, and power struggles.

name: Bhoghee
description: In a remote mountain village cut off from basic healthcare, Alaghar dreams of making his sister Kavitha a doctor. She excels against all odds, but when she travels to Chennai for college, her journey ends in tragedy. This is the story of what went wrong in a city at the peak of technological advancement.

name: Dude
description: Agan and Kural have been a part of each other's lives for as long as they can remember, sharing countless moments that have shaped who they are. As they step into a new phase of life, unforeseen challenges test their understanding of themselves and the world around them, leading them on a journey of growth, choices, and change.

name: Telusu Kada
description: Telusu Kada is a romantic drama that centers on a man caught in a complex love triangle with two women. He is forced to navigate the profound complexities of love, family, and self-discovery.

name: Avihitham
description: In a patriarchal village consumed by rumours of an illicit affair, Avihitham lays bare the absurdities of societal judgement and the relentless scrutiny of a woman`s identity.

name: Delhi Crime
description: Based on the Nirbhaya case, Delhi Crime follows the Delhi Police investigation into the finding of the men who perpetrated this crime.

name: Bhagavanth Kesari
description: A man tries to get even with a powerful businessman.

name: Nallamalai Ragasiyam
description: Dive into the mysterious and dangerous terrain of Nallamala forest, where a fearless protagonist battles crime, corruption, and evil forces lurking in the shadows. With intense action, gripping twists, and powerful performances – this movie will keep you on the edge of your seat till the very end!

name: Desiya Thalaivar
description: "Desiya Thalaivar" is a biographical film based on the life of Pasumpon Muthuramalinga Thevar, a prominent national leader and freedom fighter from Tamil Nadu. The movie explores his contributions to India

name: Marutham
description: The peaceful life of Kanniyappan, a hardworking farmer, is shattered when his ancestral farmland is auctioned off due to a mysterious unpaid loan he never took out. Devastated and shocked, Kanniyappan`s life takes a dark turn as he embarks on a desperate mission to unravel the truth behind the fraudulent auction and fight for his land.

name: Vikkatakavi
description: The king of Amaragiri calls upon the detective Ramakrishna to find the cause behind the villager's sudden memory loss. His search leads Rama to a web of political schemes and historical conspiracies.

name: Kambi Katna Kathai
description: Kambi Katna Kathai is a Tamil movie starring Natrajan Subramanian, Aarthi Shaalini, Mukesh Ravi, Singam Puli in prominent roles. It is directed by Rajanathan Periyasamy.

name: Kuttram Pudhithu
description: When Kadhiresan, a disturbed soul masked as a food delivery man, kills and gets arrested for the horrific murder of ACP Sathyas daughter Preethi, reality fractures and tensions intensify until Preethi returns from the dead unharmed five days later, challenging not just law and logic, but the very nature of truth and existence.

name: Kiss
description: A musician is gifted with the supernatural ability to see a couple

name: Vattakhanal
description: Kathiravan raises three orphans, including Sathya, grooming them to unknowingly run his illegal mushroom drug empire. After seizing control of the business by murdering his former boss, he earns the vengeful wrath of the widow, Radha. The conflict escalates when Kathiravan, threatened by Varsha

name: Bad Girl
description: Bad Girl is a coming of age drama written and directed by Varsha Bharath.

name: Junior
description: In his quest to make memories that matter, a young mans discovery sets him on a heartfelt journey that could redefine his bond with his father.

name: Desingu Raja 2
description: Three inseparable friends from an agricultural college take drastically different paths in life. One becomes a top police officer, another a dedicated inspector, and the third turns into a notorious rowdy. Years later, their lives cross again, leading to a rollercoaster of comic confrontations as friendship clashes with duty and identity. Packed with quirky side characters, over-the-top action, and unexpected twists, this high-energy comedy-action film blends laughter, emotion, and thrills into one entertaining ride.

name: Kaayal
description: A girl deeply involved in anti-suicide campaigns takes her own life after six months of self-imposed marital bondage. What reflections does her death leave on her family and loved ones? The film, in a nutshell, follows the journey of her ashes from Pondicherry to Dhanushkodi, where her family immerses them. The boy she once loved joins the journey midway and what unfolds then is the heart of the film.

name: Pagal Kanavu
description: Pagal Kanavu is a Tamil movie starring Faisal Raj, Athira Santhosh, Karate Rajan, Cool Suresh and Shakeela in prominent roles. It is written and directed by Faisal Raj.

name: Bhaje Vaayu Vegam
description: Bhaje Vaayu Vegam is a Telugu movie starring Kartikeya Gummakonda, Iswarya Menon, Rahul Haridas, Tanikela Bharani, Ravi Shankar P. and Sharath Lohitashwa in prominent roles. It is directed by Prashanth Reddy.

name: Mithra Mandali
description: A gang of good-for-nothing friends get caught in a hilarious mess between a fiery politician and his rebellious daughter, thanks to love and sheer stupidity.

name: Igloo
description: Siva (Amzath Khan) is a single parent of twin daughters, Aishu (Anika Radhakrishnan) and Vaishu (Arohi Radhakrishnan). When Vaishu realises that she knows nothing about her mother Ramya (Anju Kurian), she asks Shiva about her but he refuses to divulge any information. The situation changes when Vaishu meets with an accident and slips into a coma, bringing Shiva to finally talk about his emotional life journey with his wife.

name: Usurae
description: In the culturally rich town of Chittoor, simple Raghava falls for the spirited MBA student Ranjana. But winning her heart means facing her overprotective mother, Anusuya, a woman known for her fierce and intimidating nature. What begins as a daring challenge among friends soon blossoms into true love, forcing Raghava to navigate intense emotional trials and confront Anusuya`s formidable dominance. Will their love triumph, or is heartbreak inevitable?

name: Mr Zoo Keeper
description: A devoted zookeeper, known for his deep bond with wild animals, suddenly finds himself entangled in a troubling encounter with law enforcement, forcing him to confront a reality far removed from the sanctuary he calls home.

name: Thandakaaranyam
description: In the tribal villages along the Tamil Nadu-Karnataka border, Murugan`s admiration for uniformed services leads him to join the Indian Army after losing his job in the forest department. But once enlisted, he discovers that the reality of his dream job is far from what he imagined.

name: Kantara A Legend Chapter 1
description: The moment has arrived. The divine forest whispers. A Legend was born!

name: Maria
description: This story explores a nun`s quest for liberation, as she yearns to live a normal life. However, society and her family stand in her way. What will be her ultimate fate?

name: Sotta Sotta Nanaiyuthu
description: Sotta Sotta Ninayuthu is a heartfelt romantic drama that follows Raja, a wealthy young man struggling with insecurity about his baldness. When love blossoms with the gentle and understanding Priya, a single moment of self-doubt threatens to derail their happiness. As family pressures steer him toward Shruti, a bold, modern woman at odds with his values, Raja finds himself torn between true love and societal expectations.

name: Rangbaaz The Bihar Chapter
description: The film follows the life and times of gangster-turned-politician Haroon Ali Shah Baig, who rises from being a crook to one of the most powerful men in Bihar.

name: Lokah Chapter 1 Chandra
description: Extraordinary events unfold when an aimless trio of friends encounter their new neighbour - a mysterious young woman with a haunting past. A darkly comic fantasy thriller set in a modern-day metropolitan city, this is the first instalment of a franchise that introduces a shadow world that exists alongside our own. Starring Kalyani Priyadarshan, Naslen, Chandu, Arun Kurian and Sandy in pivotal roles, Lokah promises an entertaining ride this festive season!

name: Kothalavadi
description: In the famine-stricken village of Kothalavadi, greed sparks chaos as a ruthless scrap dealer manipulates desperate villagers into illegal sand mining, using them as pawns in his quest for power. When tragedy strikes and blood is spilt, an iron-willed officer, a betrayed enforcer, and a cunning politician clash for control. As tensions rise, the villagers must choose: break free or be consumed by their greed.

name: Blackmail
description: Blackmail is a Tamil movie starring G. V. Prakash Kumar, Teju Ashwini and Srikanth Krishnamachari in prominent roles. It is written and directed by Mu Maran.

name: Idli Kadai
description: A wealthy hotel owner is threatened by the success of a talented young idli vendor. After tasting the vendor`s unique idlis, the owner discovers the vendor is his long-lost son and the child of a former lover. As the owner decides to transfer his fortune to his newfound heir, themes of wealth, family, and identity collide, sparking a fierce conflict with his other son.

name: Suttaa Thale Enakku
description: A powerful tycoon partners with Margaya Island's kingpin to smuggle a highly valuable package. Chaos ensues when so called local gangsters and a group of tourists join forces to stop them, blending dark comedy with heart-pounding ...

name: Kishkindhapuri
description: A ghost walking tour takes a chilling turn when a group of enthusiasts enters an abandoned radio station, unwittingly awakening a vengeful spirit that begins to hunt them down.

name: Shakthi Thirumagan
description: A fearless hustler who fights for the people takes on a ruthless powerhouse, unleashing a storm of justice, rebellion, and revenge.

name: Accused
description: Accused unfolds as a gripping narrative that goes beyond action, delving into themes of love, betrayal, loyalty, and emotional turmoil. The story revolves around Kanakku, a grounded man living a peaceful life with his sister, close friends, and his beloved Malar. When a sudden tragedy disrupts his world, he is forced onto a dangerous path in search of justice. Along the way, he meets Vendhan, an emotionally scarred man entangled within the system, unaware of the power plays controlling his fate. Together, they navigate a complex web of chaos, leading to an intense and unforgettable climax.

name: Kuyili
description: After losing her husband to alcoholism, Kuyili, a woman from a marginalised village, joins the Communist Party to fight systemic injustice. Rising as a powerful voice against political corruption, her mission intensifies when she must oppose her son, now a District Collector. As tensions escalate, Kuyili becomes the target of a deadly conspiracy, but the revolution she sparked refuses to die.

name: They Call Him OG
description: After vanishing from Mumbai`s underworld for a decade, mob boss Ojas Gambheera resurfaces-feared, unstoppable, and with a single goal: to reclaim his empire and exact vengeance on the current tyrant, Omi Bhau. As loyalties fracture and alliances shift, OG reignites a brutal criminal war, confronting both external threats and haunting buried betrayals.

name: Vikram
description: A high-octane action film where a special investigator is assigned a case of serial Killings. As the investigation proceeds, he finds the case is not what it seems to be and leading down this path is only going to end in a war between everyone involved.

name: Thanal
description: Fuelled by a lifetime of suffering, an ex army man embarks on a vengeful quest. Standing in his way is a police constable whose own past pain transformed into a dutiful son. When their paths converge, hero either can flee for his life or take a stand against the villain`s scheme of things.

name: Mirage
description: In a relentless quest for the truth, Abhirami searches for her fiance, Kiran, who has mysteriously disappeared. She teams up with investigative journalist Aswin, but their pursuit of answers uncovers a complex web of secrets and questions, drawing them deeper into a mystery far greater than they ever imagined.

name: Dear Jeeva
description: Jeeva, an easygoing guy seeking a job, falls in love with Ms. Jeeva, a focused workaholic, after meeting her during an interview. They marry after an emotional journey, but trouble arises when Jeeva loses his job, and Mrs. Jeeva receives an onsite opportunity. As ego clashes build, she considers distancing herself from him. However, the unexpected Covid lockdown forces them to stay together. The story unfolds as they confront their differences and discover whether love will bring them closer or drive them apart.

name: Thayyal Machine
description: Thayyal Machine is a Malayalam movie starring Kichu Tellus, Gayathri Suresh, Sruthy Jayan, Rajiv Rajan, Rathish Pattimattom and Abhirami Rajeev in prominent roles. It is directed by C.S. Vinayan.

name: Muthal Pakkam
description: Muthal Pakkam is a Tamil movie starring Vettrii, Shilpa Manjunath, Magesh Das, Thambi Ramaiah and Redin Kingsley in prominent roles. It is directed by Anish Ashraf.

name: En Kadhale
description: En Kadhale is a Tamil movie starring Katpadi Rajan, Divya Thomas and Leya A in prominent roles. It is written and directed by Jaayalaxmi.

name: Matinee
description: Arun owns a property in Bangalore where he invites his friends for a reunion. However, Arun receives an offer for the place but along with his friends, he is trapped in the house.

name: Kurukshetra
description: An epic 18-day battle unfolds through the perspectives of 18 warriors, revealing their inner struggles and ethical challenges during a war between brothers.

name: Maya Puthagam
description: Assistant Director Guru has a dream where a book falls and a dragon pecks him out of the book. Guru meets a Swamiji who possesses the mystical book and asks about it. Swamiji gives the book to him and tells him that he should shoot the story in this book and see a producer named Sambasivam in Gandhara Hill Selvapuri Palace. Will he find a solution to his dream in Gandhara Hill Selvapuri Palace?

name: Yolo
description: Shiva finds himself mysteriously wedded to Deekshitha, a stranger. As they seek answers about their unexpected union, they unwittingly stumble into a chilling mystery that defies explanation.

name: Shanmukha
description: Shanmukha is a gripping devotional thriller that follows the journey of Suriya (Aadi Saikumar), a man destined to uncover dark, ancient truths hidden for centuries. As he embarks on an adventurous quest filled with mystery and suspense, Suriya is joined by Sara (Avika Gor), whose strength and unwavering support prove vital to his mission. Together, they navigate a world of divine forces and unravel secrets that challenge their beliefs and reshape their destinies.

name: Chengalpattu
description: Tunturu is a Kannada movie (Tamil Dubbed) starring Ramesh Aravind and Anu prabhakar in prominent roles. It is a suspense thriller directed by Mussanje Mahesh.

name: Veduvan
description: Sooraj, a struggling Tamil actor, is approached by a director to star in a biopic about Encounter Specialist Arun. As he dives deeper, he discovers there is much more to Arun’s story.

name: Mirai
description: A street-smart young man discovers he is the only answer and the shield to stop a powerful force from reaching the nine-sacred books of king Ashoka. Mirai is his journey of experiencing the power of Brahmand.

name: Tribanadhari Barbarik
description: Tribanadhari Barbarik is a Suspense thriller movie directed by Mohan Srivatsa, featuring Satya Raj and Vasishta N. Simha in prominent roles.

name: Uruttu Uruttu
description: When a village girl falls in love with a gang member accused of wronging her, her unexpected affection sets off a chain of chaos forcing her to defy her gangster father, protect a flawed man, and ultimately show him the true meaning of love.

name: Rambo
description: Rambo is a Hindi movie starring Tiger Shroff in prominent role. It is a drama directed by Siddharth Anand. If you are a representative of the production house, please share the details of the film with [email protected]

name: Search The Naina Murder Case
description: A veteran cop gets mired in a high-profile murder case when a girl is found dead in a politician's car. With multiple suspects, how will she unmask the killer?

name: War 2
description: Years ago Agent Kabir went rogue. Became India`s greatest villain ever. But this time, as he descends further into the deepest shadows India sends it`s deadliest, most lethal agent after him. A Special Units Officer who is more than Kabir`s equal! Absolutely Nuclear! Agent Vikram. A relentless Terminator driven by his own demons, determined to put a bullet into Kabir`s skull. A brutal Cat versus Rottweiler game begins as the two face off - The entire world is their brutal bloody battleground. The choices ahead of them are impossible. The price to be paid is ultimate. This is a War with spectacular action and heart-wrenching emotion.

name: Kirrak Party
description: Krishna, a first-year engineering graduate, falls in love with Meera, a final-year student. However, a tragedy befalls him and changes his perception towards life.

name: Thanga Pudhayal
description: Sunil is a gold hearted naive person. He is supposed to be a bad omen for whoever he works for which results in him transferring jobs. In the process of this shifting, he comes across a mom and a son who accept him into their family. He starts working under his brother who is now kidnapped as Sunil becomes a victim for the crime which he did not commit. How he comes out of this forms the crux of the story which is narrated in an entertaining way through out.

name: Naalai Namadhe
description: In a village ruled by the wealthy where no elections have been held for years, a young woman dares to contest, challenging power and awakening change. Inspired by Lenin`s words, the film is a bold take on reclaiming political voice and justice.

name: Bomb
description: In Kaalakammaipaati, two faith-driven sects clash endlessly. When atheist Kathiravan dies on a sacred night, but his body keeps farting, villagers deem it divine, each sect claiming him as their Gods vessel. Only his friend Mani Muthu believes hes alive, battling blind faith to save him in this satirical tale of humor, belief, and friendship

name: Janaka Aanaal
description: Janaka Aithe Ganaka is a Telugu movie starring Suhas, Sangeerthana, Venalla Kishore and Rajendra Prasad in prominent roles. It is written and directed by Sandeep Reddy Bandla.

name: The Game You Never Play Alone
description: A career-driven game developer fights back against misogynistic expectations after she becomes the target of brutal attacks online and in real life.

name: Checkmate
description: Philip Kurian, the charismatic CEO of the pharma company AnnPhil Corp, finds himself embroiled in a corporate case for deaths related to drug trials by his company. Determined to escape the charges, he resorts to unusual methods.

name: Gandhi Kannadi
description: An ambitious young event planner named Kathir sees a big opportunity when an elderly man, Gandhi, hires him to plan his 60th wedding anniversary. As their dreams and desires intertwine, their journey becomes a moving tale of love, conflict, and hope.

name: 13th Some Lessons Arent Taught In Classrooms
description: 13th tells the story of Ritesh, a successful venture capitalist who reunites with his maverick IIT-JEE mentor, Mohit Tyagi Sir, to help scale his visionary educational institute. The series unfolds against the backdrop of India's most gruelling academic competition and a startup culture fixated on valuations. At its heart, 13th is a deeply nostalgic, human story of a master and his pupil-bound by ambition, respect, and the lessons that shape a lifetime.

name: Sahasam
description: Sahasam is a gripping Malayalam drama that unfolds an unexpected adventure filled with risk, resilience, and revelation. Set against breathtaking backdrops and layered with deep emotions, it uncovers untold stories of courage hidden in ordinary lives. With stellar performances, a soulful soundtrack, and impactful storytelling, Sahasam is a journey where every choice matters and every moment counts.

name: Madharaasi
description: Madharasi is a multilingual movie starring Sivakarthikeyan, Rukmini Vasanth, Vidyut Jammwal, Biju Menon and Shabeer Kallarakkal in prominent roles. It is written and directed by A.R. Murugadoss.

name: Phoenix
description: When a boy named Surya is accused of a political murder, he`s quietly sent away to a juvenile reformatory. Hidden from the world, his fight for survival truly begins behind bars, as assassination attempts come one after another. Despite everything, Surya shows incredible resilience. The burning question remains: can he escape his past and survive this torture?

name: Hridayapoorvam
description: A man named Sandeep, who is living with a heart transplant, is coaxed into attending the engagement of his heart donor`s daughter. A twist of fate forces him to extend his stay in Pune. Over a month, he becomes intertwined with the family`s lives, and in helping them, he learns that some relationships can go beyond traditional bonds of blood and societal norms.

name: Balti
description: On the Kerala-Tamil Nadu border, in Velampalayam, where kabaddi is life, four fierce players of the Panjami Raiders rule the streets with pride and power. But when love, betrayal, and gang wars collide, brothers in arms turn into bitter rivals. Now, justice and revenge will clash in a battle where only one can stand tall.

name: Ghaati
description: A story of a woman who is a victim, a criminal and a legend.

name: Odum Kuthira Chaadum Kuthira
description: Aby, a cheerful groom, has his life turned upside down by his bride

name: Sundarakanda
description: A man, born under the Mula Nakshatra, faces endless misfortune and failed relationships. His strict criteria for a partner make things worse. One day, he meets a woman who matches his expectations. Will she accept him, and can he win her heart?

name: Kalyana Galatta
description: Kalagahatta is a Kannada movie directed by K Prakash Ambale. The movie features Abhi Das, Kushi PS, Gahana Gowda, Shobharaj and others in the pivotal roles.

name: Bakasura Restaurant
description: A wish made by five youngsters leads them to unveil a supernatural force lurking around them.

name: ID The Fake
description: ID: The Fake is a Malayalam movie starring Dhyan Sreenivasan, Divya Pillai and Kalabhavan Shajon in prominent roles. It is directed by Arun Sivavilasam.

name: Andha 7 Naatkal
description: First telescope-based movie in the Tamil industry. The story is about whether a man can change what even God cannot through the power of his love.

name: Valiyavan
description: Once Upon A Time In Vizag, there are two lovers whose story is like a love boat ride but they are hit by the Medical Mafia, their life changes. Are they gonna drown or survive this storm?

name: Meiyazhagan
description: Meiyazhagan is a Tamil movie starring Karthi and Arvind Swamy in prominent roles. It is written and directed by C. Prem Kumar.

name: Indra
description: Indra is a serial-killer investigation film about an ex-cop who lost his eyesight and sets out to catch the murderer terrorizing the town. What follows is a gripping chase full of twists and turns but what if the hunter becomes the hunted?

name: Housemates
description: Newly married Karthik and Anu buys an decade old apartment and starts their life, and starts witnessing strange things happening in their house and Simultaneously another family witnesses the same strange happenings in their house as well, both have to work together to get their house back to normal.

name: Thanel
description: Fuelled by a lifetime of suffering, an ex army man embarks on a vengeful quest. Standing in his way is a police constable whose own past pain transformed into a dutiful son. When their paths converge, hero either can flee for his life or take a stand against the villain`s scheme of things.

name: Sumathi Valavu
description: A haunted curve in Kerala, named after Sumathis tragic death, draws various people into supernatural encounters. As they experience strange events, the mystery of Sumathi and the roads dark history begins to unfold. Set in a Kerala village during the 1990s, this story unravels a chilling tale of loss and the unknown.

name: Chentha
description: Childhood friends' bond shatters when unrequited love turns to betrayal and revenge, leaving a baby caught in the crossfire.

name: Mahavatar Narsimha
description: When Faith is Challenged, He Appears. In a World torn apart by Darkness and Chaos... Witness the Appearance of the most Ferocious, The Half-Man, Half-Lion Avatar-Lord Vishnu`s Most Powerful Incarnation. Unleash the Fury! Witness the Roar of Mahavatar Narsimha.

name: Sammathame
description: Krishna wanted to get married as soon as possible and doesn`t believe in the concept of love. He then meets Saanvi and falls for her but rejects her because she had a relationship in the past. Will he ever change his ideology and accept her?

name: The Savage
description: Desires play a key role in misplaced lives of two men and two women and the violent consequences following it makes them emotionally unstable-leading them to betrayal, revenge and collision of fates that binds their lives forever

name: Detective Ujjwalan
description: In the village of Plaachikkaavu, a local detective, Ujjwalan, must outsmart a mysterious figure in a deadly battle of wits, where his skills are put to the ultimate test.

name: Jenma Natchathiram
description: A team`s treasure hunt leads them to a deserted bungalow, where they soon find themselves in a terrifying battle against paranormal dangers.

name: Do You Wanna Partner
description: Two best-friends embark on a daring journey as partners in an alcohol start-up. Unfolds their audacious journey, where they challenge norms, bend rules, and 'craft' their destiny within a male-dominated industry.

name: Kumaara Sambavam
description: An aspiring filmmaker ends up selling a family property to fund his dream. Trouble arrives in the form of a tenant who is an activist, followed by a case, the police, and some unexpected villains. What happens next forms the entertaining and engaging Kumaara Sambavam!

name: Vembu
description: Vembu follows the journey of a bold village girl passionate about martial arts. Raised by her supportive father, she dreams of excelling in martial arts while preparing for government exams. Pressured by society, she agrees to marry her cousin Vetri. Understanding her inner conflict, Vetri promises to support her dreams. As financial struggles arise, Vembu steps up to take care of the family. The film portrays her resilience and determination to rise above challenges and pursue her passion.

name: Meesha
description: Forest guard Midhun invites his friends for a feast in the forest. Mithun has his own agenda behind the invitation, but he is not the only one who has plans! Meesha is a gripping suspense drama that explores loyalty and identity at the cost of ambition. Set against the backdrop of the forest and its attachments, it dives deep into male bonding and emotional politics. Through its characters, it questions the breaking point of all loyalties and what remains after, human or inhuman?

name: Coolie
description: Coolie is a multilingual movie starring Rajinikanth in the lead role. It is directed by Lokesh Kanagaraj.

name: Enai Sudum Pani
description: Natraj Sundarraj and Upasana RC, a friendly and romantic next-door pair, lead simple lives-she is a responsible working woman, while he prepares for the IPS exam. However, as young women go missing in Pollachi and a body is found roadside, the case intensifies. As the police investigate, Natraj and Upasana unexpectedly find themselves entangled in the mystery, turning their lives upside down.

name: Raveendra Nee Evide
description: Raveendran, a weather officer obsessed with certainty, finds his world turned upside down after a strange incident involving a neighbour sparks suspicion about his wife. As doubt clouds his judgment, events spiral into a bizarre mix of confusion, a kidnapping, and a police case. Trapped in the escalating chaos, Raveendran must find a way to escape unnoticed, leading to a hilarious and unexpected quest for the truth.

name: Inspector Zende
description: When serial killer Carl Bhojraj escapes prison and resurfaces in Mumbai, the determined Inspector Zende steps up to nab the cunning fugitive once more.

name: Surrender
description: With just five days until a big election, a police team and a tough gangster find their lives dangerously tied together. Their conflict plays out with many twists, turns, and strong feelings, leading to a huge and unforgettable end.

name: Madharaasi
description: Madharasi is a Tamil movie starring Sivakarthikeyan, Rukmini Vasanth, Vidyut Jammwal, Biju Menon and Shabeer Kallarakkal in prominent roles. It is written and directed by A.R. Murugadoss.

name: The 100
description: An emotional action thriller with a powerful social message, THE 100 delivers an intriguing, gripping screenplay that keeps you hooked until the last frame.

name: Maayakoothu
description: A writer`s tale unravels a magical and mystical ride through realms unknown.

name: Paradha
description: In a remote village where women must remain veiled to ward off a curse, Subbu`s devout commitment to tradition is shattered after an enigmatic event leaving her reputation in question. Determined to clear her name, a courageous Subbu, who has rarely left her village, embarks on a daring journey to the Himalayas. She is accompanied by her aunt Rathnamma and a fierce architect named Ami, who is fighting her own battles in the modern world.

name: Kannappa
description: The movie depicts the folk tale of Kannappa, an atheist hunter who became a devotee of Lord Shiva and plucked out his eyes in an act of devotion.

name: Bun Butter Jam
description: In a delightful yet chaotic scheme, two mothers team up to marry off their son and daughter through a series of clever mind games. But as they pull the strings, they discover that reality is far more complicated than their perfectly imagined plan.

name: The Chronicles Of The 4.5 Gang
description: The five protagonists, one among them being a dwarf hailing from a slum, as they venture into the flower mafia around temples and other odd businesses to gain the respect of the public.

name: Maareesan
description: An Alzheimer`s patient escapes home with the help of a thief, who aids him to travel places not out of compassion but to eying the fortune in his bank account.

name: Peranbum Perungobamum
description: The story follows the protagonist through three pivotal phases of his life. At the heart of the narrative are the caste heads of the village, whose cruelty caused deep pain and suffering to him and his beloved. As time passes, he sets out to confront them and seek justice for the scars of the past.

name: Gevi
description: "Gevi" is a Tamil survival thriller that plunges into the struggle for justice faced by Mandharai and Malaiyan in a rural village near Kodaikanal. The film powerfully explores themes of love, survival, and bureaucratic apathy, highlighting the community`s relentless fight against corruption and adversity. It`s a gripping story of hope and resilience in the face of overwhelming odds.

name: Thalaivan Thalaivii
description: Thalaivan Thalaivii is a rugged love story that explores the fiery dynamics between a strong-willed couple. As their relationship unfolds, love, conflict, and chaos blend into a powerful emotional journey.

name: Soothravakyam
description: Christo Xavier, a circle inspector who mentors 11th-class students, transforms his station into a community center for the benefit of the kids of the town. However, he has to undergo a profound investigation due to a missing person.

name: Virgin Boys
description: After years in all-boys schools, three naive friends, Arya, Rony, and Dundi, enter a posh co-ed college. They quickly clash with the wealthy kid, Baby, and his party crowd. Amidst the chaos, Arya falls for Sarayu, Rony connects with Slokha, and Dundi brings comic mayhem trying to impress girls. This is a fun, emotional campus story of first love, friendship, rivalry, and self-discovery.

name: Love Marriage
description: Ram, a 33-year-old bachelor from Madurai, faces mounting pressure to get married. Amid cultural expectations and comic misadventures, he embarks on a journey of self-discovery, questioning tradition and seeking his own path to happiness.

name: Sthanarthi Sreekuttan
description: A mischievous seventh-grader runs for class leader to outsmart his strict teacher and popular rival, leading his friends through a string of hilarious schemes

name: Good Day
description: Santhakumar, a humiliated employee, embarks on a long walk one night, driven by rage and a need for justice. His destination: the home of his abusive manager. But instead of violence, he seeks out the managers wife to reveal the harsh truth about the exploitation and cruelty happening under her husband

name: Akkenam
description: A brave cab driver and a released convict find themselves unlikely allies as they confront a greater evil that threatens to destroy many lives.

name: Hari Hara Veera Mallu
description: Veera Mallu, a fearless warrior shaped by the hardships of his early life, emerges as the first Indian to rise against the oppressive Mughal empire. Driven by a burning desire for justice, he embarks on a daring mission to confront the ruthless actions of the army generals, igniting a revolutionary spark that could change the course of history.

name: Gamblers
description: Players gather at a hidden casino to compete for a 100 crore prize. As they play, their secret agendas surface, transforming the game into a lethal competition.

name: Andhera
description: In the shadow of Mumbai's shimmering skyline, a sinister force hunts the living. In this visceral tale of urban horror, a fearless cop and a haunted medical student must take on this living darkness to avert impending doom.

name: Nadikar
description: Nadikar showcases the journey of an accidental superstar, David Padikkal including the ups and downs of his career and life.

name: Trending
description: After their YouTube income vanishes, Arjun and Meera face financial ruin. A mysterious caller named "Mask" offers a lifeline: a high-stakes game show with big cash prizes. They reluctantly accept, only to discover they`re not just playing for money, but for their relationship itself. As the game exploits their vulnerabilities, they`re forced to confront buried secrets that could tear them apart.

name: Yaadhum Ariyaan
description: Two friends and their girlfriends on a forest getaway face horror when one girl dies mysteriously in an isolated bungalow. Panic sets in, and their desperate decisions to cover up the incident spiral into a far more terrifying ordeal.

name: Salakaar
description: A young Indian spy's covert mission interweaves with a veteran spymaster's past, revealing national secrets and hidden truths. Through intelligence and determination, they protect India's security amid sacrifice and generational burdens.

name: Court Kacheri
description: In a chaotic district court of rural India, the son of a legendary lawyer wrestles with his unwanted inheritance while cases expose the messy truth behind local justice.

name: Daaro
description: A determined woman's bold quest for vengeance as she confronts her foes, fights for justice, and takes back her power.

name: JSK Janaki V vs State of Kerala
description: Janaki, an IT professional from Bangalore, returns to her hometown in Kerala for a quiet vacation. But her peace is shattered when she becomes the victim of a horrific incident. As she begins her fight for justice, the case takes an unexpected turn with the entry of Advocate David Abel Donovan. Will Janakis pursuit of justice succeed? Or will the system test her strength and resolve?

name: Oho Enthan Baby
description: Aspiring filmmaker Ashwin believes hes found perfect love, but his emotional blindness drives her away. Heartbroken, he pours his pain into a film a story left unfinished. Now, he must choose: chase his lost love or confront himself.

name: Arabia Kadali
description: A suspenseful drama series that follows a group of fishermen from rival villages who unknowingly cross into international waters and are imprisoned in a foreign jail. Their harrowing journey evolves into a powerful saga of resilience, showcasing an unbreakable will to fight for justice. Will the fishermen make it back home? Can the two villages reunite?

name: Mayasabha
description: Two rival politicians from different backgrounds rise through Andhra Pradesh's power structure in the 1970s-80s. KKN and MSR navigate caste politics and personal ambition during a pivotal era in Indian history.

name: Show Time
description: "Show Time" is a gripping thriller that explores how an accidental murder shatters the lives of a middle-class family. The story follows a seemingly ordinary family whose world turns upside down when a momentary lapse in judgment leads to an unintended crime. As they struggle to cover up the incident, they are pulled into a web of lies, guilt, and paranoia, testing their bonds and morals.

name: Edattam
description: When the police examine the murder, Saravanan is diagnosed with a disease called dipsomania and decides not to commit murder if he does not drink too much.

name: Bakaiti
description: Set in old Ghaziabad, this heartwarming series follows the Kataria family grappling with a financial crunch. When Naina is forced to share her room with her younger brother Bharat, sibling tensions rise.

name: 3BHK
description: The life journey of Prabhu and his family - their dream to buy a home in the city, their efforts against multiple obstacles, fight against failures, heartbreaks, and whether they are able to achieve their dream or not.

name: Paranthu Po
description: In this heartwarming musical comedy, a stubborn schoolboy and his financially struggling father embark on a road trip to escape the pressures of city life. Along the way, a series of encounters with kind strangers help them uncover whats truly missing in their lives back home.

name: Guts
description: A son honors his mothers wish by becoming an honest cop, but his integrity invites relentless trials. Can he endure them and uphold justice?

name: Sarzameen
description: A father who refused to bow down to threats, a son who was given up for the nation, a family that was torn apart by the secrets and deeds of the past.

name: Maargan
description: "Maargan" is a heart-pounding murder mystery crime thriller that dives into the sinister underbelly of a chilling investigation. A seasoned high-ranking police officer grapples with a labyrinthine case, where every clue unearths a darker secret. The tension surges with the arrival of a cunning, enigmatic antagonist in their chilling debut, weaving a subtle yet electrifying web of suspense.

name: Padai Thalaivan
description: In the peaceful village of Sethumadai, Velu lives with his father and a special member, Maniyan, an elephant. In a shocking twist of fate, a priest and his men take Maniyan away, breaking Velu`s heart. Velu embarks on a challenging journey to save his beloved Maniyan.

name: Oh Bhama Ayyo Rama
description: Ram, a guy with dreams of settling abroad, finds his life flipped when Sathyabhama-a vibrant and unpredictable girl enters his world. Her chaotic charm drags him into the world of cinema, a world he once loved but left behind due to painful traumatic memories. As their bond deepens, hidden scars resurface of a lost mother, a broken past, and a passion buried under fear. But through her love and madness, Sathyabhama helps Ram rediscover the storyteller within. Oh Bhama Ayyo Rama is a heartfelt journey of love, healing, and chasing forgotten dreams-with humor, emotion, and cinematic soul.

name: Kuberaa
description: Kuberaa offers a glimpse into a world where ambition, power, and morality collide.

name: Sattamum Needhiyum
description: A courtroom drama set in the bustling world of justice, where power and privilege dominate, the series narrates the transformative journey of Sundaramoorthy.

name: Thammudu
description: Thammudu is an emotional action drama that delves into the unbreakable bond between a brother and his sister. As life throws unexpected challenges their way, the story showcases the brother`s unwavering resolve to protect his sister, making sacrifices and standing strong through misunderstandings and emotional trials.

name: Mandala Murders
description: In a quaint mysterious town of Charandaspur, where fate, myth, and murder entwine, detectives Rea Thomas and Vikram Singh unravel a chilling conspiracy of ritualistic killings tied to a centuries-old secret society.

name: Rangeen
